svg.text: 11 · Pizzerias and menus: the web page, the menu CSV with prices, the optional AI read (organiser)
Redrawn for the plan: D10 (a published CSV replaces the pasted text), D7 B (an optional price), D11 note (the web page), M3 (the AI reader).
A · Pizzerias

g.text: Loaded from the event profile; cloning

svg.text: B · A pizzeria and its menu

g.text: hidden: not in the last import

svg.text: C · Importing a menu CSV: the preview

g.text: not in the file: hidden, old orders keep it
Saved without a price; even shares then.

svg.text: D · Reading a menu photo (optional AI reader)

g.text: The photo goes to Anthropic to be read.
Nothing else is sent; the photo is not kept.
Tap a row to fix it. Nothing is saved
until the import's preview is applied.

svg.text: The web page (D11 note)
Each pizzeria has a web page, in the event profile
and here. The holder's checklist and call mode
link to it, for opening hours and today's menu.
A CSV, not pasted text (D10)
The menu import is a CSV whose spec is published
in the pizza contract: pizzerias, items with menu
numbers, names, descriptions and an optional price
(D7 B). Anyone can make one by hand or with their
own AI tool from a photo or a web page.
A preview before anything changes
Rows match the menu by number. Changed, new and
hidden items are listed. An item missing from the
file is hidden, never deleted, and old orders keep
what was ordered (D15). An error names its row and
stops the import; a warning does not.
Download
The same CSV of the current menu, to edit and
import again. It replaces the legacy's text
editor.
The optional AI read (M3, D10)
Shown only when an organiser has turned the reader
on (mockup 17). The page says before sending that
the photo goes to an outside provider. The result
is a menu CSV that goes through the same preview:
nothing counts until a person applies it.
Right
pizza.menu.write (D5).
